brief:
An Israeli strike devastated a residential home in Gaza City's al-Shati refugee camp, al Jazeera English reported. The attack caused heavy damage to multiple surrounding structures in the densely populated area, destroying or severely compromising several neighboring dwellings.

Al-Shati, located in Gaza City, is one of the territory's largest refugee camps, housing tens of thousands of Palestinian residents across a confined urban area. The strike represents the latest in a pattern of Israeli military operations affecting civilian infrastructure and residential neighborhoods throughout Gaza. Rescue and recovery efforts were underway in the aftermath of the strike.
dek: An Israeli strike devastated a home in Gaza City’s al-Shati refugee camp, heavily damaging surrounding homes.
title: Israeli strike devastates home in Gaza's al-Shati refugee camp
